name: Eleanor Davies
bio:
Eleanor's path to motorsport was somewhat unconventional, starting with a childhood obsession with Meccano sets and a knack for fixing anything mechanical. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, she initially worked in the automotive industry, but the lure of racing proved too strong. She volunteered at a local racing team, quickly proving her talent in data analysis and simulator development. 

Eleanor is known for her meticulous approach to simulator engineering. She believes in constant refinement, pushing the boundaries of realism to provide the drivers with the most accurate training environment possible. Her strength lies in her ability to translate real-world car behavior into precise code. A rising star at Rexal FMI Racing, Eleanor is dedicated to improving the team's simulation program.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eleanor is of average height with a serious, focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool in her pocket.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of Earl Grey tea throughout the day.
